title: Grateful Dead Live at Glen Helen Regional Park on 1982-09-05
lineage: Cassette Master (Nakamichi DR-1/Dolby B) -> Sound Devices 744T (24bit/48k) -> Samplitude Professional v11.03 -> FLAC/16
source: (FOB) Sony ECM-220T -> Cassette Master (Sony TC-D5M/Fuji Metal Tape/Dolby B)

ai_review.summary: Decent acoustic FOB capture of a high‑energy US Festival set; recording is good but suffers from thin bass and vocal echo.
ai_review.review: The three reviewers all praise the performance – calling it a strong show from one of the Dead’s peak touring periods and even “fantastic” despite the festival setting. The front‑of‑house (FOB) source is described as generally solid, though one reviewer notes thin bass, a bit of vocal echo and less punch than smaller venues, suggesting the stadium acoustics limited fidelity. Overall the show shines more than the recording’s technical quirks.

ai_rating.rationale: High praise for the performance (average 4.7 stars) offset by consistent comments about modest recording flaws, yielding a solid but not perfect combined rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: FOB capture is clear enough, but bass sounds thin, vocals have slight echo and the overall punch is reduced – likely due to large stadium PA acoustics.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Typical concise festival slot; the set flows well despite limited time.
